initiatives.title: O(n²) percentage calculation in AssetDistributionChart legend
initiatives.description: Each legend item recalculates total via accountData.reduce() inside map. Pre-compute percentages in useMemo for O(n) performance.

initiatives.title: Negative account balances crash AssetDistributionChart percentages
initiatives.description: Negative account balances pass to pie chart producing negative percentages and rendering errors. Chart should filter to positive balances only and show warning.

initiatives.title: FamilySettingsV2 duplicates Firestore listeners from useFamilySharing
initiatives.description: FamilySettingsV2 sets up own onSnapshot listeners instead of using useFamilySharing hook. Creates 6 concurrent listeners for same data. State can diverge between components.

initiatives.title: Profile name fires Firestore write on every keystroke - no debounce
initiatives.description: ProfileSettings onChange calls updateProfile immediately. Typing John triggers 4 Firestore writes and 4 audit logs. Performance and cost disaster on mobile.

initiatives.title: writeBatch wipe data can exceed Firestore 500-op limit
initiatives.description: handleWipeData uses single writeBatch for all collections. Users with 500+ total documents get Firestore error. No chunking logic.

initiatives.title: MFA timeout stale closure - error never fires
initiatives.description: handleGenerateMfaSecret timeout captures pre-setState isEnrolling value (false). Condition isEnrolling && !mfaQrUrl always false. 10-second timeout error never displays.

initiatives.title: Hardcoded naira in charts - AssetDistributionChart and CashFlowChart
initiatives.description: Both chart components hardcode naira symbol instead of using account currency. Wrong symbol shown for USD accounts in all visualizations.

initiatives.title: RecurringTransactionsList hardcodes NGN currency symbol
initiatives.description: RecurringTransactionsList always displays naira symbol regardless of transaction currency. USD recurring transactions show wrong symbol.

initiatives.title: calculateNetWorth.total ignores USD entirely
initiatives.description: Net worth calculation only sums NGN balances. USD account balances are silently excluded from total net worth.

initiatives.title: 30 Day Summary is actually 28 days and uses today not selected month
initiatives.description: The 30 Day Summary card always calculates from today minus 28 days, ignoring which month the user has selected. Shows current data even when viewing past months.

initiatives.title: MonthlyInsight uses first account currency for multi-currency totals
initiatives.description: Multi-currency users see meaningless sums. NGN + USD added together using NGN symbol. Should either convert via exchange rate or show per-currency totals.

initiatives.title: No monthly opening/closing balance - always shows today
initiatives.description: Finance view always displays current balance regardless of which month is selected. Users cannot see what their balance was at end of previous months.

initiatives.title: 15+ touch targets below 44px platform minimum
initiatives.description: WeeklyView toggle 24px, MonthlyDates 32px, TaskItem checkbox 32px, AssetAllocation expand 16px, notification toggles 24px, toast dismiss 24px, nav hamburger 36px. All below Apple 44px and Google 48px minimums.

initiatives.title: Loading overlay blocks all scrolling with pointer-events-none
initiatives.description: Dashboard loading overlay applies pointer-events-none to body, blocking all scroll and touch. Screen appears frozen during data loads.

initiatives.title: Toast notifications min-w-300px overflows on small phones
initiatives.description: Toasts have min-w-[300px] + right-6 positioning. On 375px phones, toasts are cut off on left edge.

initiatives.title: autoComplete=off blocks mobile autofill on email and password
initiatives.description: Auth forms use autoComplete=off which blocks iOS/Android password autofill. 97% mobile users must hand-type credentials.

initiatives.title: min-h-screen used instead of dvh throughout auth and onboarding
initiatives.description: 6+ files use min-h-screen which does not account for mobile browser chrome. Content hidden behind URL bar. Should use min-h-dvh.

initiatives.title: 1300ms hard delay before financial confirmation dialog
initiatives.description: Finance flow has setTimeout 1300ms before showing confirmation. Users think app is frozen while waiting for dialog.

initiatives.title: WeeklyView forces min-w-800px - unusable on mobile
initiatives.description: WeeklyView component has min-w-[800px] hardcoded. 375px phones show horizontal scroll bar, content unreadable. 97% users are mobile.

initiatives.title: Push notification disable toggle broken - cannot turn off
initiatives.description: NotificationContext disable path only changes React state. FCM token not deleted from Firestore, browser permission stays granted, useEffect re-restores token on mount. Users cannot disable push.

initiatives.title: handleDeleteAccount is no-op - GDPR violation
initiatives.description: SettingsView handleDeleteAccount shows toast and logs out but does not delete data. No Cloud Function, no Firestore purge, no Firebase Auth deletion. User data persists forever.

initiatives.title: Transfers double-counted in all summary aggregations
initiatives.description: Transfers stored as income/expense type. MonthlyInsight, CashFlowChart, and all summaries include them, showing 2x actual income and expenses.

initiatives.title: Type change income to expense produces zero balance correction
initiatives.description: Changing transaction type from income to expense without changing amount causes silent balance corruption due to wrong sign logic.

initiatives.title: Transfer deletion race condition - getDoc outside transaction
initiatives.description: Transfer deletion reads paired transaction with getDoc() outside Firestore runTransaction block. Race condition causes double-deletion or orphaned half-transfers.

initiatives.title: Cross-currency transfer edit corrupts destination balance
initiatives.description: Editing a cross-currency transfer applies source currency amount to destination account balance, corrupting multi-currency balances.

initiatives.title: Transaction scope field missing - as any cast hides undefined scope
initiatives.description: addTransaction in TransactionForm.tsx omits scope field, hidden by as any cast. All transactions stored with scope: undefined, breaking shared account filtering entirely.
